consequence.statement: Environments simply gain the new ExternalArtifact (v1) API; nothing existing is stated to break, but operators who manage CRDs separately from the release should install or update the CRDs before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: If CRDs are managed separately from the release, install or update the CRDs before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The computed artifact diff between the install bundles adds a new CRD externalartifacts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io serving the ExternalArtifact kind (v1) in group source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, and operators who manage CRDs separately from the release are advised to install or update CRDs before upgrading.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The subject is a newly added CRD/GVK: no pre-existing environment usage can exist and the evidence states no environment state under which any consequence occurs, so there is no exposure condition to express.
